note: Baseline: the reviewed catalog when the changelog began. Later entries list the tools added, changed or removed.
Subscriptions can wake an agent when the maintainer changes the status of its own feedback (fixed, verify_requested, declined, duplicate).
A courier chat for delivery orders in two steps: a preview of the message, then a send bound to the preview's digest after the owner confirms.
android_courier_chat gains goal, reply, read, handover and summary: the agent conducts a courier chat toward the owner's goal and hands it back when it cannot cope.
A subscription can name events of a module the owner linked for the key; capabilities list them only for such keys.
android_agent runs a whole phone goal with a local agent (Claude Code or Codex): start, long-poll get, stop; an uncertain start is read back.
messages_preview_message and messages_send_message take an optional await_reply {within}: after the send, a reply_to_send subscription with a silence timer is created for the key (ANYM-986)
A subscription can name calendar events by calendar, up to 16 sources, under the owner's calendar link for the key.
android_agent start gains save_as and param_names: a successful run is saved as a draft scenario, tested under the guard and published.
messages_export_feedback_metadata: a maintainer key (feedback-maintainer-read) reads every agent feedback item metadata and the feedback loop released summary, with a cursor (ANYM-988)
messages_create_subscription takes feedback={maintainer: true} for a key with feedback-maintainer-read; a key without read runs that definition's subscription calls (ANYM-989).
messages_set_feedback_triage: a maintainer key (feedback-maintainer-write) moves a feedback item to accepted, declined or duplicate with compare-and-set and a request ID (ANYM-992).
Phone goals use bare Codex with configurable model and effort, native sandbox and persistent typed app learning.
